name: M24 Aircraft Parachute Flare
blurb: A Hangar-only aircraft parachute flare with deployed canopy and a geometry-only burning-lamp marker; it adds no beam, smoke or illumination effect.
history: The M24 was an aircraft-dropped parachute flare documented by the U.S. War Department. The manual fixes the canister's overall dimensions and weight; this model uses those values and clearly marks the deployed canopy and lamp form as estimates.
